Three arms have identical primary reporting; duplicate-next and future-two have identical 0.5 weights and auxiliary-logit interface, differing only target offset. Full model will require native and duplicate-head controls.
Independent scalar math.fsum shifted LSE/analytic gradients for every actual coordinate and native/0.5 coefficients; six new literal families B1-2/T1-9/V3-23. Exact hardcoded alignment/storage check.

26 typed/shape/range/device/nonfinite/missing-aux/native-extra-aux/bounds rejections plus autocast each backend, checking original inputs/gradslots. No CPU64-to-MPS conversion; outputs transfer CPU before FP64 comparisons.

All measurements/pairs published before numeric rejection. Fixed CE3e-5 and gradient4e-6/4e-5 unchanged; CPU64 strict oracle separate. Global CPU/MPS RNG finally restored and asserted. No random seed/generator/draw calls found by AST.

Nonblocking shared worker flock and 120s CPU/600s MPS/4GiB RSS/6GiB MPS/8GiB reserve/2MiB metadata gates;1GiB RSS+256MiB MPS/30s forecast. Complete metadata+reserve+extra2GiB fits35.13GB. No tensor files or deletion need.

No old source/weight audits, tests, numerical cases or campaigns replayed. 1224 predecessors remain untouched. Two new sources1226 future bindings, not changed scientific runtime1211. Tiny success cannot admit real model or full quality.
